_README: SYNTHETIC CONTRACT FIXTURES -- NOT A RECORDING OF PRODUCTION.
Every response in this file was CONSTRUCTED from the committed API
contract (packages/contract/index.d.ts) and its worked example. None of
it was captured from api.metagraph.sh, and none of it describes real
Bittensor state. The numbers are a deterministic synthetic series chosen
to exercise chart geometry; they must never be cited as observed data.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS, AND WHEN IT SHOULD DISAPPEAR
GET /api/v1/chain/subnet-price-share-composition is implemented on this
branch but is NOT yet deployed -- api.metagraph.sh returns 404 for it
(verified 2026-08-21, against a 200 control on /api/v1/chain/activity).
The homepage's only live visual reads that endpoint, so without a fixture
13 homepage e2e tests have nothing to render.
ssr-supplement.json was the obvious place and is the wrong one: it is
documented as recorded production bytes, and api-stub's record() refuses
to persist even a real non-2xx response on the grounds that 'a recorded
error is worse than a gap'. Writing invented bytes into that file would
launder fiction as a capture. Hence a separate, human-readable file whose
name and contents say what it is.
The stub loads this LAST, so any real HAR or supplement entry wins. Once
the endpoint ships, record the real response and delete the entry here.
